description: Cargo, npm/pnpm, Dockerfile and GitHub Actions updates as pull requests into main, proved by ci.yml like any change (T-3860). Minor and patch bumps come as one weekly pull request, because each one costs a ci run; a major comes alone. Nothing is proposed before it is 7 days old (the owner's dependency cooldown, as in the deployment config); digests stay pinned; nothing merges by itself.

packageRules.description: One weekly pull request for every minor and patch bump
